text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: p99 latency SLO breach (service: model-serving-prod, region: us-west). Alert PD-78910. auto-page to on-call.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-78910 -> Claire (primary) notified, escalation will occur in 2m if unacknowledged.

claire_oncall: acked. I'm looking. Thanks. :eyes:

mike_sre: seeing tail at 1200ms p99 for text-gen. p95 up to ~350ms. Any deploys?

claire_oncall: no deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot. Checking autoscaler and kv cache metrics.

sahil_reliability: I can pull hotkeys and recent request distribution. running: `curl -s http://metrics/api/queries?m=hotkeys`

jess_prod: customer-impact: some interactive customers reported slow completions (chat UI). No 500s observed.

mike_sre: logs show increased queue depth on workers in us-west-2: `queue.depth > 80` for pool gpu-small-2. Looks like uneven routing.

claire_oncall: trying a quick reroute to region fallback policy for traffic > 500ms: `kubectl apply -f /runbooks/reroute-fallback-us-west.yaml`

ops-bridger: note: that will shift ~12% of traffic to us-east. Keep an eye on cost but do it.

incident-bot: Action executed: reroute policy applied by claire_oncall.

mike_sre: after reroute p99 trending down to 480ms. p95 steady ~200ms. queue depth dropping.

claire_oncall: paging escalation suppressed. I'm leaving a canary at 2m; will hand off if it stabilizes.

pagerduty: Claire acknowledged PD-78910 at 1789012470. Escalation timer paused.

jess_prod: customer ops: notifying CS for impacted tenants, suggested message drafted.

sahil_reliability: captured hotkey list and a small spike from tenant-42, top key ~130k qps in a minute. Looks like a synthetic test or runaway batch.

mike_sre: can we throttle tenant-42 at the edge and ask them to pause? Rate-limit rule ready: `ratelimit tenant-42 100r/s`

claire_oncall: applied rate-limit for tenant-42. re-evaluating metrics.

mike_sre: p99 down to 260ms now, p95 180ms. queue depths normalizing.

claire_oncall: good. leaving monitoring. if stable for 10m I'll clear the page and open a follow-up postmortem.

jess_prod: noted — CS will follow up. No confirmed data loss, only latency and UX degradation.

incident-bot: Incident note: mitigation steps: reroute -> limit tenant-42 -> stabilised. Marking alert as mitigated.

claire_oncall: cleared the page at 1789012485. handing to mike for post-incident triage.

mike_sre: taking triage. I'll capture traces, kv-cache hit/miss deltas, and run a targeted replay of tenant-42 traffic in staging.

sahil_reliability: I'll correlate with recent model cache evictions; uploading graphs to the incident doc.

jess_prod: tagging impacted customers; drafting follow-up timeline.

claire_oncall: thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bridger: add runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-p99-burn

mike_sre: ETA for postmortem draft 24h.

claire_oncall: thread closed for paging. Will reopen if alert returns.
